Method of Attack: Default credentials enabled during the image build process
Virtual machine images built using the Proxmox provider do not disable default credentials
Impacted Systems: Kubernetes clusters using virtual machine images created via the Image Builder project with the Proxmox provider
Attack Vector: Exploitation of default credentials to gain root access

Method of Attack: Default credentials enabled during image builds using Nutanix, OVA, QEMU, or raw providers
Impacted Systems: VMs using images built with Nutanix, OVA, QEMU, or raw providers
Attack Vector: Attacker modifies the image during the build process

Method of Attack: Authentication bypass via fake ending in Solr API URL path
Impacted Systems: Apache Solr instances running versions from 5.3.0 before 8.11.4 and 9.0.0 before 9.7.0
Attack Vector: Fake ending in Solr API URL path to skip authentication

Method of Attack: Improper authentication allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network

Missing authorization allows an unauthenticated attacker to view sensitive information through a network attack vector
